column1: # Closed word classes for the morphology: pronouns, numerals, month names,
# prepositions, conjunctions and particles. Written for gramoten from Bulgarian
# grammar (2026-11-03), not taken from any word list; licensed with the code (MIT).
# Read by hunspell_morph.py. Format: form <TAB> lemma <TAB> tag. Tags as in
# src/gramoten/morphology.py. A form may have several lines (several readings).
# -- possessive pronouns (Pposs): full forms decline like adjectives
# -- nouns endings cannot place: plural-only nouns and irregular plurals (N)
# adjectives whose е/я alternation splits their forms in the dictionary (A)
